full_judgment:
Syed J.R. Mudassir Hussain, J: This Criminal Petition for leave to appeal has arisen out of judgment and order dated 26-7-2000 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 4423 of 1999 and order dated 8-7-1999 of the learned Sessions Judge, Satkhira in Criminal Revision Case No. 145 of 1998 allowing the same by accepting the naraji petition of the informant as complainant by setting aside the order dated 16-11-1998 of the Magistrate (Kha), Area Satkhira passed in GR Case No. 180 of 1988 arising out of Satkhira police station Case No. 35 dated 30-5-1998 under sections 143/326/379/109 of the Penal Code by accepting the final report so far as it relates to the petitioners. 

 3. Upon the aforesaid allegations the police started case under sections 143/323/324/326/307/379/109 of the Penal Code and thereafter police started investigation into the case and after completion of the same submitted charge-sheet on 18-10-1998 under sections 143/323/324/326/307/379 and 199 of the Penal Code against accused Anwarul Islam and five others and submitted final report in respect of the petitioners. The Magistrate, Satkhira, received the charge-sheet and on perusal thereof took cognizance of the case against Anwarul Islam and five others, accepted final report in respect of the petitioners and released them from the case by his order dated 1-11-1998. Against the said acceptance of the final report, the informant MA Hannan, made naraji petition but the Magistrate rejected the same by his order dated 16-11-1998 and thereupon the informant respondent No. 2 moved a revisional application before the learned Sessions Judge, Satkhira, who upon hearing both the parties allowed the revisional application by his judgment and order dated 8-7-1999 passed in Criminal Revision No. 145 of 1998 and thereby set aside the order dated 16-11-1998 of the Magistrate rejecting the naraji petition.
